combo.description: All in a target, opening with Q W AA, then quickly E them and W R.
Begin an all in by knocking a target up with E, then quickly W Q R. When the ult channel ends, W and AA.
Execute a low health target by hitting them with Q and R.
When you hit an E pre-6, follow up with W Q, then A W AA.
Proc your passive twice by using Q W quickly, then E W.
Short trade by using E and then quickly W.
